name: Bhushan
title: Machine Learning Engineer
bio: I am a Machine Learning Engineer focused on Agentic AI, RAG systems, and LLM orchestration. I build production AI systems that are useful in the messy middle: reliable retrieval, practical agents, clean evaluation loops, and services that teams can actually operate.
My work sits between applied research and product engineering. I like small, testable systems, clear interfaces, and models that earn trust through behavior rather than demos.
